nominated_retune: Wire secondary=mage scorer contribution: dual-scorer blend (ehp primary + mage secondary at reduced weight) so AP items (Malignance, Rabadon's, Stormsurge, Sorcerer's Shoes) can enter the ranked pool.
headline: Malphite ehp scorer surfaces pure-tank items; empirical ARAM winners are AP mage items (Mercury's 54.5%, Rabadon's 51.4%, Sorcerer's 50.8%) with zero scorer-pool presence.
